# TenderLab

## Resource centre
- [TenderLab resource centre](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/resources): Free tender assessments, eligibility and bid decision tools, pricing and mobilisation calculators, response improvement builders and practical UK care tender guides.
- [Tender readiness assessment](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/resources/tools/tender-readiness-assessment): Evidence-led preliminary readiness diagnosis for UK care providers.
- [Tender eligibility checker](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/resources/tools/tender-eligibility-checker): Condition-by-condition check against a live procurement.
- [Bid / No-Bid decision tool](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/resources/tools/bid-no-bid): Recorded opportunity qualification decision.
- [Score My Response](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/resources/tools/score-my-response): Structured self-check against the question, specification and published scoring descriptors.

> TenderLab is a UK tender-writing and bid consultancy specialising in health and social care procurement.

Canonical website: https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/
Legal entity: TenderLab Ltd, Companies House number 17184263
Contact: info@tenderlab.co.uk | +44 1707 240393
Service area: United Kingdom

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/): TenderLab's positioning, main routes and verified experience measures.
- [Services](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/services): Compare bid writing, independent review, readiness, coaching, pipeline, mobilisation and retained support.
- [Bid writing](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/services/bid-writing): Complete tender-writing support for a live opportunity.
- [Care settings](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/care-settings): Sector-specific evidence priorities across adult social care, children's services, housing and clinical services.
- [Live tenders](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/tenders): Published UK health and social care opportunities sourced through TenderLab's live tender feed.
- [Case studies](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/case-studies): Procurement-specific examples of TenderLab's work and recorded outcomes.
- [Blogs](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/blog): Practical articles on health and social care procurement.
- [Results and proof](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/proof): Definitions and limitations for TenderLab's four verified experience measures.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/faqs): Answers about scope, evidence, timescales, sectors and tender outcomes.
- [About TenderLab](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/about): Legal, editorial and service accountability.
- [Contact](https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/contact): Telephone, email, address and enquiry form.

## Important interpretation notes

- TenderLab's 92% recorded historic win rate, 200+ submissions supported, £50M+ aggregate client contract value and documented 5/5 question-level evaluator scores are separate management measures. Their definitions and limitations are published on the proof page.
- Past performance does not guarantee a future contract award.
- Live tender summaries are discovery aids. The relevant official notice, procurement documents, clarification messages and buyer portal remain the final source for deadlines and requirements.
- TenderLab articles explain procurement practice; they do not replace the current tender pack, regulator guidance or professional legal advice.
- Use https://www.tenderlab.co.uk/ as TenderLab's canonical website.
